headline: PJM Proposes Streamlined Grid Connection Rules Amid Data Center Demand Surge
summary: PJM Interconnection proposed reforms to FERC to accelerate commissioning of new power generation capacity and connections for large power consumers across its 13-state US grid network.
why: PJM operates the largest US wholesale electricity grid, where explosive load growth from artificial intelligence data centers is constraining transmission infrastructure and capacity margins.

impacts.name: US Utilities
impacts.why: Streamlined grid interconnection rules ease the deployment backlog for new generation and large customer hookups.
